purpose: Execute a phased, verifiable architecture modernization of the marketing-automation publishing stack to eliminate 5-minute retry storms, automate platform maintenance window pauses, prune severe codebase bloat, and unify state authority.
design_intent: Move from defensive, heroic fallback chains and fragmented state files to an authoritative state machine, proactive history-driven gating, clean maintenance window parsing, and pruned scripts.
problem_statement: The publisher currently suffers from severe architectural coupling (double browser launches), conflicting configurations (hardcoded 5-min loops overriding hourly limits), unhandled platform maintenance (503s treated as critical crashes), and script sprawl (>55KB orphaned scripts).

phases.name: Immediate Bloat Pruning & Script Hygiene
phases.model_rationale: Mechanical file removals, dead reference scrubbing, and script pruning require fast execution speed and low latency. Runs in automated small batches with Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) git diff verification.

session_boundary.stop_condition: Orphaned scripts deleted, package.json cleaned, lint:structure and test:unit passing.
session_boundary.continuation_prompt: Continue with Phase 2 of publisher-architecture-modernization-v1: implement the proactive 60-minute cooldown gatekeeper and eliminate the hardcoded 5-minute retry loop in lib/scheduler/run.ts per .planning/spec-kit/specs/active/phase2-publisher-scheduler-stabilization-v1.json.

phases.name: Publisher & Scheduler Stabilization (Hourly Cooldown & Loop Elimination)
phases.model_rationale: Involves timing calculations, scheduler loop redesign, backoff scheduling, and Playwright dialog event interception.

session_boundary.stop_condition: Pre-flight history check active, 5m spin loop replaced with cooldown alignment, alert dialogs captured, tests passing.
session_boundary.continuation_prompt: Continue with Phase 3 of publisher-architecture-modernization-v1: implement the platform maintenance window regex parser and scheduler pause engine per .planning/spec-kit/specs/active/phase3-maintenance-engine-v1.json.

phases.name: Platform Maintenance Detection & Dynamic Pause Engine
phases.model_rationale: Requires robust Korean datetime regex extraction, timezone normalization (KST/UTC), scheduler timer pause integration, and Slack alert deduplication.

session_boundary.stop_condition: Maintenance parser handles datetime ranges, scheduler respects maintenanceBlockedUntil, Slack disarms failure alarms on 503, tests passing.
session_boundary.continuation_prompt: Continue with Phase 4 of publisher-architecture-modernization-v1: execute state unification, publisher state machine consolidation, and elimination of the legacy bot.ts adapter per .planning/spec-kit/specs/active/phase4-state-architecture-consolidation-v1.json.

phases.name: Architecture Consolidation, Unified State & Micro-File Cleanup
phases.recommended_model: Hybrid (Flash Med for caller repointing; Flash High for state unification)
phases.model_rationale: State store unification and FSM lifecycle require strong reasoning; repointing imports across callers and inlining micro-files is executed via automated batching with Flash Med.

session_boundary.stop_condition: State store unified, micro-files inlined into flow.ts, bot.ts deleted, full test and lint suite passing with 0 regressions.
session_boundary.continuation_prompt: All 4 phases of publisher-architecture-modernization-v1 are complete. Review handover and run full system regression checklist.
